title: How to update
summary: When new patches come out, patch BaconReader again with Morphe Manager: Android updates the app and keeps your login and settings.
body:
- Morphe Manager gets the new patches when it starts, or when you tap **Update** on the source in **Sources**.
- Then, on **Apps**, tap **BaconReader Premium** (or **BaconReader**), then **Patch**, then **Install → Update**. Not the install button next to **Open**: it installs the copy patched before, with the patches of then.
- The bottom of BaconReader's left menu shows which patches are installed, such as "Patches 1.8.2 (Morphe)".
caption: Morphe Manager updates BaconReader Premium to the newest BaconReader patches
recorded: Recorded on a Pixel 6 Pro with Morphe Manager 2.5.0.
gherkin:
@phone
Scenario: Morphe Manager updates BaconReader Premium to the newest BaconReader patches
  Given Morphe Manager is installed
  And Morphe Manager has the source "JoanComasFdz BaconReader Patches" at 1.8.1
  And the BaconReader patches 1.8.2 are released
  And the BaconReader Premium 6.1.4 APK is in Downloads
  When I tap "BaconReader Premium"
  And I tap "No, I already have it" on "Need help finding the APK?"
  And I tap "BaconReaderPremium-6.1.4.apk"
  Then Morphe Manager shows "Patched", with the source "JoanComasFdz BaconReader Patches 1.8.1"
  When I tap "Install"
  And I tap "Install" on "Install this app?"
  And I tap "Cancel" on "Would you like to be notified when updates are available?"
  And I tap "Skip" on "Quick feature tour"
  And I open BaconReader
  And I tap "Don’t allow" on "Allow BaconReader Premium to send you notifications?"
  And I tap "Not now" on "Open Reddit links with BaconReader?"
  And I open the left menu
  Then the bottom of the left menu shows "Patches 1.8.1 (Morphe)"
  When I open Morphe Manager
  And I tap "Sources"
  And I tap the source "JoanComasFdz BaconReader Patches"
  And I tap "Update" on the source "JoanComasFdz BaconReader Patches"
  Then the source "JoanComasFdz BaconReader Patches" shows the version "1.8.2"
  When I tap "Apps"
  And I tap "BaconReader Premium"
  And I tap "Patch"
  Then Morphe Manager shows "Patched", with the source "JoanComasFdz BaconReader Patches 1.8.2"
  When I tap "Install"
  And I tap "Update" on "Update this app?"
  And I tap "Open"
  And I open the left menu
  Then the bottom of the left menu shows "Patches 1.8.2 (Morphe)"
